# FUEL MARF -> MASTERLIST mapping profile (design v0.7, sections C, J, M, N).
# Matching uses normalised header keys (fuel_parser.headers.match_key), never column letters.
profile_id: marf-v3
source:
  preferred_sheet: "MARF RAW"
  header_row: 1
  # Header signature that identifies the response sheet; all other sheets are ignored (M.2, H-33).
  signature_keys: ["timestamp", "sales leader", "lead source", "seller name"]

  response_fields:
    timestamp: ["timestamp"]
    submitter_email: ["email address"]
    sales_leader: ["sales leader"]
    lead_source: ["lead source"]
    awareness: ["source of awareness"]

  # A client block starts at each `seller name` header and holds these 10 keys (D.1).
  block:
    start_key: "seller name"
    fields:
      seller_name: "seller name"
      surname: "client's surname"
      first_name: "client's first name"
      middle_name: "client's middle name"
      mobile: "mobile no. (client)"
      client_email: "email address (client)"
      residence: "residence address (client)"
      project_first: "project of interest (first choice)"
      project_second: "project of interest (second choice)"
      remarks: "remarks"

  # Response-level conditional details. Several aliases = v2 and v1 wording of the same question.
  details:
    booth: ["if booth, please choose which booth location below", "if booth, please specify booth location"]
    referrer: ["name of existing buyer who referred the client to you"]
    corporate: ["if corporate, please choose below"]
    digital_official: ["if digital - official social media, please choose below"]
    digital_seller: ["if digital - seller social media, please choose below"]
    digital_v1: ["digital"]
    own_source: ["if own source, please choose below", "own source"]
    referral_v1: ["referral"]
    repeat_buyer: ["if repeat buyer, please choose from the listed projects below", "projects owned/bought by client"]
    roadshow: ["if roadshow, please specify below the name and date of roadshow event (e.g. filinvest alabang roadshow - january 1, 2026)"]
    saturation: ["if saturation, please specify exact location below", "if saturation, please specify location"]
    showroom: ["if showroom walk-in, please specify which showroom below"]
    sponsorship:
      - "if sponsorship event, please specify below the name and date of event (e.g. cardiologist conference 2026 - january 1, 2026)"
      - "if sponsorship event, please specify name of event & date (e.g. cardiologist conference 2026 - january 1, 2026)"
    seller_fb_page: ["if digital - seller facebook page, please choose below", "seller facebook page"]

  # "Others, please specify" columns share a header, so each is resolved as the column
  # immediately after its anchor question (F.3), then checked against its parent (J.5).
  others:
    - {id: others_corporate, key: "if others, please specify below", after: "if corporate, please choose below", label: "Corporate", parent: corporate}
    - {id: others_digital_seller, key: "if others, please specify below", after: "if digital - seller social media, please choose below", label: "Digital - Seller Social Media", parent: digital_seller}
    - {id: others_own_source, key: "if others, please specify below", after: "if own source, please choose below", label: "Own Source", parent: own_source}
    - {id: others_repeat_buyer, key: "if others, please specify below", after: "if repeat buyer, please choose from the listed projects below", label: "Repeat Buyer", parent: repeat_buyer}
    - {id: others_lead_source, key: "if others, please specify below", after: "if sponsorship event, please specify below the name and date of event (e.g. cardiologist conference 2026 - january 1, 2026)", label: "Lead Source", parent: lead_source}
    - {id: others_own_source_v1, key: "if others, please specify", after: "own source", label: "Own Source", parent: own_source}
    - {id: others_referral_v1, key: "if others, please specify", after: "referral", label: "Referral", parent: referral_v1}
    - {id: others_digital_v1, key: "if others, please specify", after: "digital", label: "Digital", parent: digital_v1}
    - {id: others_repeat_project_v1, key: "if others, please specify project", after: "projects owned/bought by client", label: "Repeat Buyer", parent: repeat_buyer}
    - {id: others_lead_source_v1, key: "if others, please specify", after: "if others, please specify project", label: "Lead Source", parent: lead_source}

destination:
  sheet: "MASTERLIST"
  # sha256 of the exact template header row (cells joined by U+001F). A mismatch stops the run (M.2).
  template_header_sha256: "0b78ee85f80e91820144927e0783a6c0513cce16e652add0db4993e8c3688c0d"
  # Field id per destination column, in template order (35 columns, section B).
  columns:
    - id
    - start_time
    - completion_time
    - email
    - name
    - sales_leader
    - seller_name_1
    - seller_email_1
    - seller_name_2
    - seller_email_2
    - seller_name_3
    - seller_email_3
    - surname
    - first_name
    - middle_name
    - mobile
    - client_email
    - residence
    - project_first
    - project_second
    - remarks
    - lead_source
    - booth
    - referrer
    - question
    - digital_official
    - digital_seller
    - own_source
    - repeat_buyer
    - roadshow
    - saturation
    - showroom
    - sponsorship
    - awareness
    - seller_fb_page
  datetime_columns: [start_time, completion_time]
  datetime_format: "m/d/yy h:mm"

# Lead Source -> the one detail column that feeds SPECIFIC LEAD SOURCE (I.3).
lead_source_detail:
  "Booth Manning": booth
  "Buyer Referral": referrer
  "Corporate": question
  "Digital - Official Social Media": digital_official
  "Digital - Seller Social Media": digital_seller
  "Own Source": own_source
  "Repeat Buyer": repeat_buyer
  "Roadshow": roadshow
  "Saturation": saturation
  "Showroom Walk-In": showroom
  "Sponsorship Event": sponsorship

# Second-level details that legitimately accompany a Lead Source (not orphans).
lead_source_secondary:
  "Digital - Seller Social Media": [seller_fb_page]

leads_log:
  # Exact team-sheet headers, trailing spaces included (I.1).
  headers: ["TIMESTAMP ", "SELLER EMAIL ADDRESS", "AAD", "AS", "SURNAME (CLIENT)", "FIRST NAME (CLIENT)", "MIDDLE NAME (CLIENT)", "MOBILE NO. ", "EMAIL ADDRESS", "RESIDENCE ADDRESS", "PROJECT (FIRST CHOICE)", "PROJECT (SECOND CHOICE)", "REMARKS", "LEAD SOURCE ", "SPECIFIC LEAD SOURCE", "LEAD SOURCE (DISTINCT)", "SOURCE OF AWARENESS"]
  timestamp_format: "mmm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss"

"""Audit workbook: reconciliation, mapping status, review list and row log (design F.5, G, N.2)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

from .config import file_sha256
from .model import RecordStatus, Severity
from .writer import set_text

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from .pipeline import RunOptions, RunResult

_BOLD = Font(bold=True)
_REVIEW_SEVERITIES = (Severity.ERROR, Severity.HELD, Severity.WARNING)


def _sheet(wb, title: str, header: list[str]):
    ws = wb.create_sheet(title)
    ws.append(header)
    for c in ws[1]:
        c.font = _BOLD
    ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
    _next_row[id(ws)] = 2
    return ws


_next_row: dict[int, int] = {}


def _append(ws, values: list[object]) -> None:
    # Track the next row ourselves: openpyxl's max_row scans every cell (quadratic on big sheets).
    r = _next_row[id(ws)] if id(ws) in _next_row else ws.max_row + 1
    _next_row[id(ws)] = r + 1
    for c, v in enumerate(values, start=1):
        cell = ws.cell(r, c)
        if isinstance(v, (datetime, int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool):
            cell.value = v
        elif v is not None:
            set_text(cell, str(v))


def mapping_status_rows(result: "RunResult") -> list[list[object]]:
    cfg = result.cfg
    per_leader: dict[str, Counter] = defaultdict(Counter)
    for rec in result.records:
        per_leader[rec.sales_leader][rec.status.value] += 1
    rows = []
    for leader in sorted(per_leader):
        team = cfg.teams.lookup(leader) if leader else None
        c = per_leader[leader]
        held = sum(v for k, v in c.items() if k != RecordStatus.EXPORTED.value)
        rows.append([
            leader or "(blank)",
            team.status if team else "UNRESOLVED (not in teams.yaml)",
            team.slot if team and team.exportable else None,
            team.describe() if team else "No entry",
            c.get(RecordStatus.EXPORTED.value, 0),
            held,
        ])
    return rows


def write_audit(path: Path, result: "RunResult", opts: "RunOptions") -> None:
    cfg = result.cfg
    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Summary"
    _next_row[id(ws)] = 1
    ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 70
    ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 70
    by_status = Counter(r.status.value for r in result.records)
    owner_exported = sum(1 for r in result.exported if r.slot_status == "OWNER_APPROVED_UNVERIFIED")
    lines: list[list[object]] = [
        ["FUEL Response Parser — audit report", ""],
        ["Mode", "DRY RUN (no import file, ledger unchanged)" if result.dry_run else "EXPORT"],
        ["Batch id", result.batch_id],
        ["Generated", datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")],
        ["Source file", Path(opts.source).name],
        ["Source sha256", result.source_sha256],
        ["Response sheet used", result.sheet.sheet_name],
        ["Other sheets ignored", ", ".join(result.sheet.ignored_sheets) or "(none)"],
        ["Template file", Path(opts.template).name],
        ["Template sha256", file_sha256(opts.template)],
        ["Mapping profile sha256", cfg.profile.sha256],
        ["Header signature", result.cmap.signature],
        ["Vocabulary sha256", cfg.vocab.sha256],
        ["Validation policy sha256", cfg.policy.sha256],
        ["Teams config sha256", cfg.teams.sha256],
        ["Seller directory", f"{cfg.sellers.source} ({len(cfg.sellers.emails)} approved) {cfg.sellers.sha256}"],
        ["Team filter", ", ".join(opts.team_filter) if opts.team_filter else "(all teams)"],
        ["", ""],
    ]
    if result.previous_batches:
        lines.append(["WARNING: this source file was exported before",
                      "; ".join(f"{b.batch_id} ({b.records_exported} exported)" for b in result.previous_batches)])
        lines.append(["", ""])
    lines += [
        ["Headline",
         f"Exported: {len(result.exported) - owner_exported} verified · {owner_exported} owner-approved (unverified) · "
         f"Held for review: {by_status.get('REVIEW', 0)} · Duplicates held: {by_status.get('DUPLICATE_HELD', 0)} · "
         f"Already imported: {by_status.get('ALREADY_IMPORTED', 0)} · Excluded by filter: {by_status.get('EXCLUDED_BY_FILTER', 0)}"],
        ["", ""],
        ["Reconciliation", "Value"],
    ]
    lines += [[k, v] for k, v in result.counts.items()]
    lines += [["", ""], ["Reconciliation check", "Result"]]
    lines += [[name, "PASS" if ok else "FAIL"] for name, ok, _ in result.checks]
    issue_counts = Counter((i.code, i.severity.value) for r in result.records for i in r.issues)
    issue_counts.update((i.code, i.severity.value) for i in result.response_issues)
    lines += [["", ""], ["Issue code (severity)", "Count"]]
    lines += [[f"{code} ({sev})", n] for (code, sev), n in sorted(issue_counts.items())]
    for line in lines:
        _append(ws, line)
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        if row[0].value in ("Reconciliation", "Reconciliation check", "Issue code (severity)", "Headline"):
            row[0].font = row[1].font = _BOLD

    ms = _sheet(wb, "MappingStatus", ["SALES LEADER", "Status", "Slot", "Evidence / approval", "Records exported", "Records held"])
    for row in mapping_status_rows(result):
        _append(ms, row)

    dest_fields = [f for f in cfg.profile.dest_columns if not f.startswith("seller_") and f != "id"]
    rv = _sheet(wb, "Review", ["Status", "Reasons", "Action", "Source row", "Block", "SALES LEADER", "Slot status",
                               "Seller name", "Seller e-mail", "Lead source (received)", "Duplicate group"] + dest_fields)
    for rec in sorted(result.records, key=lambda r: (r.source_row, r.block_index or 0)):
        flagged = [i for i in rec.issues if i.severity in _REVIEW_SEVERITIES]
        if rec.status == RecordStatus.EXPORTED and not flagged:
            continue
        if rec.status in (RecordStatus.ALREADY_IMPORTED, RecordStatus.EXCLUDED_BY_FILTER) and not flagged:
            continue
        codes = list(dict.fromkeys(f"{i.code}" + (f"[{i.field}]" if i.field else "") for i in flagged))
        actions = list(dict.fromkeys(cfg.policy.action.get(i.code, "") for i in flagged if cfg.policy.action.get(i.code)))
        _append(rv, [rec.status.value, "; ".join(codes), " ".join(actions), rec.source_row, rec.block_index,
                     rec.sales_leader, rec.slot_status, rec.meta.get("seller_name"), rec.meta.get("seller_email"),
                     rec.lead_source_original, rec.duplicate_group] + [rec.values.get(f) for f in dest_fields])
    for i in result.response_issues:
        _append(rv, ["REVIEW", i.code, cfg.policy.action.get(i.code, ""), i.source_row, None, None, None, None, None, None, None])

    iss = _sheet(wb, "Issues", ["Source row", "Block", "Record key", "Code", "Severity", "Field", "Message"])
    for rec in result.records:
        for i in rec.issues:
            _append(iss, [rec.source_row, rec.block_index, rec.src_key[:12], i.code, i.severity.value, i.field, i.message])
    for i in result.response_issues:
        _append(iss, [i.source_row, None, "", i.code, i.severity.value, i.field, i.message])

    rl = _sheet(wb, "RowLog", ["Source row", "Block", "Status", "Output Id", "Record key", "Lead source (received)", "Issue codes"])
    entries = [(r.source_row, r.block_index or 0, [r.source_row, r.block_index, r.status.value, r.dest_id, r.src_key,
                r.lead_source_original, ", ".join(dict.fromkeys(r.codes()))]) for r in result.records]
    entries += [(i.source_row, 0, [i.source_row, None, "REVIEW", None, "", "", i.code]) for i in result.response_issues]
    for _, _, row in sorted(entries, key=lambda e: (e[0], e[1])):
        _append(rl, row)

    mp = _sheet(wb, "Mapping", ["Column", "Source header", "Result", "Target", "Note"])
    for p in result.cmap.preview:
        _append(mp, [p.letter, p.header, p.kind, p.target, p.note])

    um = _sheet(wb, "Unmapped", ["Column", "Source header", "Note"])
    for p in result.cmap.preview:
        if p.kind in ("IGNORED_EMPTY",) or p.target == "ignore":
            _append(um, [p.letter, p.header, p.note])

    if opts.team_sheet_check and result.sheet.path.suffix.lower() in (".xlsx", ".xlsm"):
        team_sheet_check(wb, result)  # opt-in reference comparison; never an input (H-33)
    wb.save(path)


# -- optional comparison with the derived team sheets (M.2) -------------------------------

_TEAM_FIELDS = {  # Leads Log header -> how to read our record
    "SELLER EMAIL ADDRESS": lambda r: r.values.get("email"),
    "AAD": lambda r: r.sales_leader,
    "AS": lambda r: r.meta.get("seller_name"),
    "SURNAME (CLIENT)": lambda r: r.values.get("surname"),
    "FIRST NAME (CLIENT)": lambda r: r.values.get("first_name"),
    "MIDDLE NAME (CLIENT)": lambda r: r.values.get("middle_name"),
    "MOBILE NO.": lambda r: r.values.get("mobile"),
    "EMAIL ADDRESS": lambda r: r.values.get("client_email"),
    "RESIDENCE ADDRESS": lambda r: r.values.get("residence"),
    "PROJECT (FIRST CHOICE)": lambda r: r.values.get("project_first"),
    "PROJECT (SECOND CHOICE)": lambda r: r.values.get("project_second"),
    "REMARKS": lambda r: r.meta.get("remarks_original"),
    "LEAD SOURCE": lambda r: r.lead_source_original,
    "SOURCE OF AWARENESS": lambda r: r.values.get("awareness"),
}
_MULTI = {"PROJECT (FIRST CHOICE)", "PROJECT (SECOND CHOICE)", "SOURCE OF AWARENESS"}


def _norm(v: object, header: str, null_tokens: set[str]) -> str:
    if v is None:
        return ""
    s = str(v).strip()
    if s.upper() in {t.upper() for t in null_tokens}:
        return ""  # team sheets upper-case values, so placeholders are compared case-insensitively
    s = s.upper()
    if header in _MULTI:
        s = re.sub(r"[;,\s]", "", s)
    return s


def _ts_key(v: object) -> int | None:
    return round(v.timestamp()) if isinstance(v, datetime) else None


def team_sheet_check(wb, result: "RunResult") -> None:
    """Compare our records with the team sheets' cached values (reference only, case-insensitive).

    SPECIFIC / DISTINCT are excluded (I.5 X7). Values are not copied into the report.
    """
    src = openpyxl.load_workbook(result.sheet.path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    try:
        sheets = []
        for name in src.sheetnames:
            if name == result.sheet.sheet_name:
                continue
            rows = list(src[name].iter_rows(max_row=10, values_only=True))
            for idx, row in enumerate(rows):
                labels = [str(c).strip().upper() if c is not None else "" for c in row]
                if "TIMESTAMP" in labels and "AAD" in labels and "AS" in labels:
                    sheets.append((name, idx + 1, labels))
                    break
        if not sheets:
            return
        ours: dict[tuple, list] = defaultdict(list)
        for rec in result.records:
            k = (_ts_key(rec.timestamp), _norm(rec.values.get("surname"), "", set()))
            ours[k].append(rec)
        nulls = result.cfg.vocab.null_tokens
        stats: dict[str, Counter] = defaultdict(Counter)
        mismatches, unmatched = [], 0
        compared = 0
        for name, hrow, labels in sheets:
            col = {lab: i for i, lab in enumerate(labels) if lab}
            for n, row in enumerate(src[name].iter_rows(min_row=hrow + 1, values_only=True), start=hrow + 1):
                row = list(row)
                ts = row[col["TIMESTAMP"]] if col.get("TIMESTAMP") is not None and col["TIMESTAMP"] < len(row) else None
                if ts is None:
                    continue
                sur_i = col.get("SURNAME (CLIENT)")
                # Team sheets hold timestamps as float day serials, which drift by up to ±1 s.
                base, sur = _ts_key(ts), _norm(row[sur_i] if sur_i is not None else None, "", set())
                recs = None
                if base is not None:
                    recs = next((ours[(base + d, sur)] for d in (0, -1, 1) if (base + d, sur) in ours), None)
                if not recs:
                    unmatched += 1
                    continue
                rec = recs[0]
                compared += 1
                for header, getter in _TEAM_FIELDS.items():
                    i = col.get(header)
                    if i is None or i >= len(row):
                        continue
                    if _norm(row[i], header, nulls) == _norm(getter(rec), header, nulls):
                        stats[header]["match"] += 1
                    else:
                        stats[header]["mismatch"] += 1
                        mismatches.append([name, n, rec.source_row, header])
        ws = _sheet(wb, "TeamSheetCheck", ["Field (reference: team sheets, case-insensitive)", "Matched", "Mismatched"])
        _append(ws, ["Team-sheet rows compared", compared, None])
        _append(ws, ["Team-sheet rows with no matching record", unmatched, None])
        for header in _TEAM_FIELDS:
            _append(ws, [header, stats[header]["match"], stats[header]["mismatch"]])
        ws2 = _sheet(wb, "TeamSheetMismatches", ["Team sheet", "Team-sheet row", "Source row", "Field"])
        for m in mismatches:
            _append(ws2, m)
    finally:
        src.close()

"""Command-line interface (design F.1). Works entirely on local files."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import logging
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

from .audit import mapping_status_rows
from .config import ConfigError, load_config, normalise_label
from .history import Ledger
from .mapping import MappingError
from .pipeline import NeedsConfirmation, ReconciliationError, RunOptions, prepare, run
from .reader import ReadError, read_sheet
from .writer import TemplateError

DEFAULT_LEDGER = Path("output/import_history.sqlite")


def _common(p: argparse.ArgumentParser) -> None:
    p.add_argument("--source", required=True, type=Path, help="Google Forms response export (.xlsx or .csv)")
    p.add_argument("--template", required=True, type=Path, help="FUEL (MGM-AD ADMIN) workbook with the MASTERLIST sheet")
    p.add_argument("--config-dir", type=Path, default=Path("config"))
    p.add_argument("--profiles-dir", type=Path, default=Path("profiles"), help="Saved mapping confirmations")
    p.add_argument("--sellers", type=Path, help="Reviewed seller directory (.csv or .yaml); default config/sellers.csv|yaml")
    p.add_argument("--teams", type=Path, help="Alternative teams.yaml")
    p.add_argument("--sheet", help="Response sheet name (confirms a proposed sheet)")
    p.add_argument("--timestamp-format", action="append", dest="timestamp_formats",
                   help="Confirmed strptime format for text timestamps in CSV exports, e.g. '%%m/%%d/%%Y %%H:%%M:%%S'")
    p.add_argument("--accept-suggestions", action="store_true", help="Confirm suggested header matches (saved per header signature)")
    p.add_argument("--ignore-unmapped", action="store_true", help="Confirm that listed unmapped columns are ignored (saved)")


def _options(a: argparse.Namespace, **extra) -> RunOptions:
    return RunOptions(
        source=a.source, template=a.template, out_dir=getattr(a, "out_dir", Path("output")),
        config_dir=a.config_dir, ledger_path=getattr(a, "ledger", DEFAULT_LEDGER), profiles_dir=a.profiles_dir,
        sellers_path=a.sellers, teams_path=a.teams, sheet=a.sheet, timestamp_formats=a.timestamp_formats,
        accept_suggestions=a.accept_suggestions, ignore_unmapped=a.ignore_unmapped, **extra)


def _print_preview(cmap) -> None:
    kinds = Counter(p.kind for p in cmap.preview)
    print(f"Header signature {cmap.signature}: {len(cmap.blocks)} client blocks; "
          + ", ".join(f"{k} {v}" for k, v in sorted(kinds.items())))
    for p in cmap.preview:
        if p.kind != "MATCHED":
            print(f"  {p.letter:>3}  {p.kind:<13} {p.header[:60]!r:<64} {p.target} {p.note}")

    try:
        _, sd, cmap = prepare(_options(a))
    except NeedsConfirmation as e:
        print(f"NEEDS CONFIRMATION: {e}")
        if e.cmap:
            _print_preview(e.cmap)
        print("Re-run with --sheet, --accept-suggestions and/or --ignore-unmapped after checking the items above.")
        return 2
    print(f"Response sheet '{sd.sheet_name}': {len(sd.rows)} responses, {sd.blank_rows} blank rows"
          + (f"; ignored: {', '.join(sd.ignored_sheets)}" if sd.ignored_sheets else ""))
    _print_preview(cmap)
    print("Mapping complete: no item needs confirmation.")

def cmd_run(a) -> int:
    opts = _options(a, last_id=a.last_id, team_filter=a.team, leads_log=a.leads_log, dry_run=a.dry_run,
                    team_sheet_check=a.team_sheet_check)
    try:
        r = run(opts)
    except NeedsConfirmation as e:
        print(f"NEEDS CONFIRMATION: {e}")
        if e.cmap:
            _print_preview(e.cmap)
        print("Nothing was written. Check the items, then re-run with --sheet / --accept-suggestions / --ignore-unmapped.")
        return 2
    if r.previous_batches:
        print("WARNING: this exact source file was exported before: "
              + ", ".join(f"{b.batch_id} ({b.records_exported} exported)" for b in r.previous_batches))
    c = r.counts
    print(f"{'DRY RUN — ' if a.dry_run else ''}Batch {r.batch_id}")
    print(f"  Response sheet: '{r.sheet.sheet_name}'" + (f" ({len(r.sheet.ignored_sheets)} other sheet(s) ignored)" if r.sheet.ignored_sheets else ""))
    print(f"  Responses read: {c['responses']}  (blank rows {c['blank_rows']}, no client data {c['responses_no_client']}, "
          f"multi-block {c['responses_multi_block']})")
    print(f"  Records built: {c['records_built']} = exported {c['records_exported']} + review {c['records_review']} + "
          f"duplicates held {c['records_duplicate_held']} + already imported {c['records_already_imported']} + "
          f"excluded by filter {c['records_excluded_by_filter']}")
    for name, ok, _ in r.checks:
        print(f"  [{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}] {name}")
    print("  Mapping status:")
    for leader, status, slot, desc, exp, held in mapping_status_rows(r):
        print(f"    {leader[:45]:<45} {status:<26} slot {slot or '-'}  exported {exp:>5}  held {held:>5}")
    codes = Counter(i.code for rec in r.records for i in rec.issues) + Counter(i.code for i in r.response_issues)
    print("  Issues: " + ", ".join(f"{k} {v}" for k, v in sorted(codes.items())))
    for kind, path in r.outputs.items():
        print(f"  {kind:<9} {path}")
    if not a.dry_run and c["records_exported"]:
        print("Next: check the Review sheet, then append the import file to the live MASTERLIST yourself. "
              f"If you do not use it, run: fuel-parser void-batch {r.batch_id}")

def cmd_batches(a) -> int:
    for b in Ledger(a.ledger).list_batches():
        print(f"{b.batch_id}  {b.created_at}  {b.status:<8} exported {b.records_exported:>5}  {b.source_file_name}")
    return 0

    print(f"Batch {a.batch_id} voided: {n} record key(s) released.")

def cmd_preflight(a) -> int:
    """Count SALES LEADER x filled seller slot in a MASTERLIST export (evidence for M.4)."""
    cfg = load_config(a.config_dir)
    sd = read_sheet(a.masterlist, cfg.profile.dest["sheet"])
    from .headers import match_key
    keys = [match_key(h) for h in sd.headers]
    idx = {k: i for i, k in enumerate(keys)}
    pairs = {1: ("seller name", "seller's email address"), 2: ("seller name1", "seller's email address1"),
             3: ("seller name2", "seller's email address2")}

    for _, row in sd.rows:
        leader = normalise_label(row[idx["sales leader"]])
        filled = [n for n, (nk, ek) in pairs.items() if row[idx[nk]] or row[idx[ek]]]
        counts[leader][tuple(filled) if filled else ("none",)] += 1
    print(f"MASTERLIST export: {len(sd.rows)} rows")
    for leader, c in sorted(counts.items()):
        slots = {s for key in c for s in key if s != "none"}
        total = sum(c.values())
        verdict = ("CONSISTENT" if len(slots) == 1 and total >= 3 and all(len(k) == 1 for k in c)
                   else "CONTRADICTION" if len(slots) > 1 else "INSUFFICIENT")
        print(f"  {leader[:45]:<45} rows {total:>5}  slots {dict(c)}  -> {verdict}")
    print("CONSISTENT leaders may be recorded in teams.yaml as VERIFIED with evidence_type: masterlist_export "
          "and evidence_ref: <file name + sha256>. Nothing was changed automatically.")
    return 0


def cmd_draft_directory(a) -> int:
    """Draft the seller directory for human review (J.1). Output contains personal data: keep it local."""
    cfg = load_config(a.config_dir)
    from .mapping import resolve
    from .pipeline import _nonempty_counts
    from .reader import choose_sheet
    src = cfg.profile.source
    sheet = a.sheet or choose_sheet(a.source, src["preferred_sheet"], src["signature_keys"]).name
    sd = read_sheet(a.source, sheet)
    cmap = resolve(sd.headers, cfg.profile, _nonempty_counts(sd))
    sub_col = cmap.response["submitter_email"]
    by: dict[str, Counter] = defaultdict(Counter)
    sellers_of: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)
    for _, row in sd.rows:
        for b in cmap.blocks:
            name = row[b.columns["seller_name"]]
            if name and str(name).strip():
                n, e = str(name).strip(), str(row[sub_col] or "").strip().lower()
                by[n][e] += 1
                sellers_of[e].add(n)
    with open(a.out, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(["seller_name", "proposed_email", "responses", "share_pct", "other_emails", "email_also_used_for",
                    "review_flags", "status", "reviewer_email", "reviewer_note"])
        for n, c in sorted(by.items()):
            (e, k), *rest = c.most_common()
            share = round(100 * k / sum(c.values()), 1)
            flags = [f for f, on in (("TIE", bool(rest) and rest[0][1] == k), ("LOW_SHARE", share < 80),
                                     ("EMAIL_USED_FOR_OTHER_SELLERS", len(sellers_of[e]) > 1)) if on]
            w.writerow([n, e, sum(c.values()), share, " | ".join(f"{x} ({v})" for x, v in rest),
                        " | ".join(sorted(sellers_of[e] - {n})), ",".join(flags) or "OK", "DRAFT - NOT APPROVED", "", ""])
    print(f"Draft directory written to {a.out} ({len(by)} sellers). Set status to APPROVED or REJECTED per row, "
          "then save it as config/sellers.csv (git-ignored).")
    return 0


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.WARNING, format="%(levelname)s %(message)s")
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="fuel-parser", description="FUEL response export -> MASTERLIST import file")
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    p = sub.add_parser("preview", help="Show the sheet and mapping preview")
    _common(p)
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_preview)

    p = sub.add_parser("run", help="Validate, transform and write the import and audit files")
    _common(p)
    p.add_argument("--out-dir", type=Path, default=Path("output"))
    p.add_argument("--ledger", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_LEDGER)
    p.add_argument("--last-id", type=int, help="Last Id in the live MASTERLIST (required when records are exported)")
    p.add_argument("--team", action="append", help="Export only these SALES LEADER prefixes (others are counted as excluded)")
    p.add_argument("--leads-log", action="store_true", help="Also write the optional 17-column Leads Log")
    p.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Audit only: no import file, ledger unchanged")
    p.add_argument("--team-sheet-check", action="store_true",
                   help="Also compare against the workbook's team sheets in the audit (reference only; off by default)")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_run)

    p = sub.add_parser("batches", help="List import batches in the ledger")
    p.add_argument("--ledger", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_LEDGER)
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_batches)

    p = sub.add_parser("void-batch", help="Release a batch whose output was never appended to the live MASTERLIST")
    p.add_argument("batch_id")
    p.add_argument("--ledger", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_LEDGER)
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_void)

    p = sub.add_parser("preflight-masterlist", help="Count SALES LEADER x seller slot in a MASTERLIST export")
    p.add_argument("--masterlist", required=True, type=Path)
    p.add_argument("--config-dir", type=Path, default=Path("config"))
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_preflight)

    p = sub.add_parser("draft-directory", help="Draft the seller directory CSV for review")
    p.add_argument("--source", required=True, type=Path)
    p.add_argument("--out", required=True, type=Path)
    p.add_argument("--sheet")
    p.add_argument("--config-dir", type=Path, default=Path("config"))
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_draft_directory)

    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        return a.func(a)
    except (ConfigError, MappingError, ReadError, TemplateError, ReconciliationError, ValueError, KeyError) as e:
        print(f"ERROR: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Header normalisation and alias matching (design section C).

Headers are matched by meaning through a normalised *match key*, never by
column letter.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import difflib
import re
import unicodedata

_SUFFIX = re.compile(r"\s+\d+$")
_SPACE = re.compile(r"\s+")


def match_key(header: object) -> str:
    """Return the normalised match key for a header cell.

    NFKC -> NBSP to space -> lower-case -> collapse whitespace -> strip ->
    drop the Google duplicate suffix (`` 2``, `` 13``) -> drop a trailing ``:``.
    """
    if header is None:
        return ""
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", str(header)).replace(" ", " ")
    text = _SPACE.sub(" ", text.lower()).strip()
    text = _SUFFIX.sub("", text).strip()
    return text.rstrip(":").strip()


def suggest(key: str, candidates: list[str], cutoff: float = 0.85) -> str | None:
    """Closest alias for an unmatched key. A suggestion is never auto-accepted."""
    found = difflib.get_close_matches(key, candidates, n=1, cutoff=cutoff)
    return found[0] if found else None

"""Local import ledger (design D.5). Stores hashes and row numbers only, never client data."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

_SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS import_batch (
    batch_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_file_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_file_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_sheet TEXT NOT NULL,
    mapping_profile_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    responses_read INTEGER NOT NULL,
    records_built INTEGER NOT NULL,
    records_exported INTEGER NOT NULL,
    records_review INTEGER NOT NULL,
    records_skipped INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    output_path TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS imported_record (
    src_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    batch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES import_batch(batch_id),
    source_row INTEGER NOT NULL,
    dest_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    exported_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_imported_content ON imported_record(content_hash);
"""


@dataclass
class BatchRow:
    batch_id: str
    created_at: str
    source_file_name: str
    records_exported: int
    status: str
    output_path: str


class Ledger:
    def __init__(self, path: Path):
        self.path = Path(path)
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with closing(self._connect()) as con:
            con.executescript(_SCHEMA)

    def _connect(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
        return sqlite3.connect(self.path)

    def imported_keys(self) -> set[str]:
        with closing(self._connect()) as con:
            return {r[0] for r in con.execute("SELECT src_key FROM imported_record")}

    def imported_content_hashes(self) -> set[str]:
        with closing(self._connect()) as con:
            return {r[0] for r in con.execute("SELECT content_hash FROM imported_record")}

    def batches_for_file(self, sha256: str) -> list[BatchRow]:
        with closing(self._connect()) as con:
            rows = con.execute(
                "SELECT batch_id, created_at, source_file_name, records_exported, status, output_path "
                "FROM import_batch WHERE source_file_sha256 = ? AND status = 'exported' ORDER BY created_at", (sha256,)).fetchall()
        return [BatchRow(*r) for r in rows]

    def list_batches(self) -> list[BatchRow]:
        with closing(self._connect()) as con:
            rows = con.execute(
                "SELECT batch_id, created_at, source_file_name, records_exported, status, output_path "
                "FROM import_batch ORDER BY created_at").fetchall()
        return [BatchRow(*r) for r in rows]

    def record_export(self, batch: dict, records: list[tuple[str, int, int, str]]) -> None:
        """Write the batch and its exported keys in one transaction.

        `records` holds (src_key, source_row, dest_id, content_hash).
        """
        now = datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")
        with closing(self._connect()) as con, con:
            con.execute(
                "INSERT INTO import_batch VALUES (:batch_id, :created_at, :source_file_name, :source_file_sha256, "
                ":source_sheet, :mapping_profile_id, :responses_read, :records_built, :records_exported, "
                ":records_review, :records_skipped, 'exported', :output_path)", {**batch, "created_at": now})
            con.executemany(
                "INSERT INTO imported_record VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                [(k, batch["batch_id"], row, did, ch, now) for k, row, did, ch in records])

    def void_batch(self, batch_id: str) -> int:
        """Release a batch's keys (its output was never appended to the live MASTERLIST)."""
        with closing(self._connect()) as con, con:
            cur = con.execute("SELECT status FROM import_batch WHERE batch_id = ?", (batch_id,)).fetchone()
            if cur is None:
                raise KeyError(f"Unknown batch: {batch_id}")
            if cur[0] == "voided":
                return 0
            n = con.execute("DELETE FROM imported_record WHERE batch_id = ?", (batch_id,)).rowcount
            con.execute("UPDATE import_batch SET status = 'voided' WHERE batch_id = ?", (batch_id,))
            return n

"""Core data model shared by all pipeline stages."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum


class Severity(str, Enum):
    ERROR = "ERROR"
    HELD = "HELD"
    WARNING = "WARNING"
    INFO = "INFO"


class RecordStatus(str, Enum):
    EXPORTED = "EXPORTED"
    REVIEW = "REVIEW"
    DUPLICATE_HELD = "DUPLICATE_HELD"
    ALREADY_IMPORTED = "ALREADY_IMPORTED"
    EXCLUDED_BY_FILTER = "EXCLUDED_BY_FILTER"


@dataclass
class Issue:
    code: str
    severity: Severity
    source_row: int
    field: str
    message: str
    record_key: str = ""


@dataclass
class SourceResponse:
    """One data row of the response sheet, values keyed by column index."""

    row: int
    values: dict[int, object]


@dataclass
class Record:
    """One destination record built from one filled client block."""

    source_row: int
    block_index: int | None
    values: dict[str, object] = field(default_factory=dict)
    meta: dict[str, object] = field(default_factory=dict)
    issues: list[Issue] = field(default_factory=list)
    src_key: str = ""
    content_hash: str = ""
    client_key: str = ""
    duplicate_group: str = ""
    lead_source_original: str = ""
    sales_leader: str = ""
    seller_slot: int | None = None
    slot_status: str = ""
    timestamp: datetime | None = None
    status: RecordStatus | None = None
    dest_id: int | None = None

    def add(self, code: str, severity: Severity, fieldname: str, message: str) -> None:
        self.issues.append(Issue(code, severity, self.source_row, fieldname, message))

    def has(self, severity: Severity) -> bool:
        return any(i.severity == severity for i in self.issues)

    def codes(self) -> list[str]:
        return [i.code for i in self.issues]

"""Orchestrate one run: read -> map -> build -> de-duplicate -> reconcile -> write (design F.2).

UI-agnostic: the CLI and the Streamlit app both call `run()`.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import uuid
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from . import audit
from .build import RecordBuilder
from .config import Config, file_sha256, load_config
from .history import BatchRow, Ledger
from .mapping import (ColumnMap, decisions_from_preview, header_signature, load_decisions, resolve,
                      save_decisions)
from .model import Issue, Record, RecordStatus, Severity, SourceResponse
from .reader import SheetData, choose_sheet, list_sheets, read_sheet
from .writer import leads_log_row, read_template_header, write_leads_log, write_masterlist

log = logging.getLogger("fuel_parser")


class NeedsConfirmation(Exception):
    """The run cannot continue until the user confirms the sheet or mapping items."""

    def __init__(self, message: str, cmap: ColumnMap | None = None, sheet: str | None = None):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.cmap = cmap
        self.sheet = sheet


class ReconciliationError(RuntimeError):
    """Counts do not balance; nothing is exported (AC2)."""


@dataclass
class RunOptions:
    source: Path
    template: Path
    out_dir: Path
    config_dir: Path = Path("config")
    ledger_path: Path = Path("output/import_history.sqlite")
    profiles_dir: Path = Path("profiles")
    sellers_path: Path | None = None
    teams_path: Path | None = None
    sheet: str | None = None
    last_id: int | None = None
    team_filter: list[str] | None = None
    leads_log: bool = False
    dry_run: bool = False
    timestamp_formats: list[str] | None = None
    accept_suggestions: bool = False
    ignore_unmapped: bool = False
    team_sheet_check: bool = False  # opt-in: other sheets are ignored by default (H-33)
    now: datetime | None = None


@dataclass
class RunResult:
    batch_id: str
    sheet: SheetData
    cmap: ColumnMap
    records: list[Record]
    response_issues: list[Issue]
    counts: dict[str, int]
    checks: list[tuple[str, bool, str]]
    previous_batches: list[BatchRow]
    source_sha256: str
    outputs: dict[str, Path] = field(default_factory=dict)
    cfg: Config | None = None
    dry_run: bool = False

    @property
    def exported(self) -> list[Record]:
        return [r for r in self.records if r.status == RecordStatus.EXPORTED]


def _nonempty_counts(sd: SheetData) -> dict[int, int]:
    counts: dict[int, int] = defaultdict(int)
    for _, row in sd.rows:
        for i, v in enumerate(row):
            if v is not None and not (isinstance(v, str) and v.strip() == ""):
                counts[i] += 1
    return counts


def prepare(opts: RunOptions) -> tuple[Config, SheetData, ColumnMap]:
    """Load config, validate the template, choose the sheet and resolve the mapping."""
    cfg = load_config(opts.config_dir, opts.sellers_path, opts.teams_path)
    read_template_header(opts.template, cfg.profile)  # stops on schema mismatch before any output
    src = cfg.profile.source
    if opts.sheet:
        sheet = opts.sheet
        ignored = [n for n in list_sheets(opts.source) if n != sheet]
    else:
        choice = choose_sheet(opts.source, src["preferred_sheet"], src["signature_keys"], src.get("header_row", 1))
        sheet, ignored = choice.name, choice.ignored
        if choice.needs_confirmation:
            raise NeedsConfirmation(f"Several sheets look like response sheets. Proposed sheet: '{sheet}'. "
                                    "Confirm it by passing the sheet name explicitly.", sheet=sheet)
    sd = read_sheet(opts.source, sheet, src.get("header_row", 1))
    sd.ignored_sheets = ignored
    nonempty = _nonempty_counts(sd)
    sig = header_signature(sd.headers)
    decisions = load_decisions(opts.profiles_dir, sig)
    cmap = resolve(sd.headers, cfg.profile, nonempty, decisions)
    if cmap.needs_confirmation and (opts.accept_suggestions or opts.ignore_unmapped):
        new = decisions_from_preview(cmap, sd.headers, opts.accept_suggestions, opts.ignore_unmapped)
        if new:
            save_decisions(opts.profiles_dir, sig, new)
            decisions.update(new)
            cmap = resolve(sd.headers, cfg.profile, nonempty, decisions)
    if cmap.needs_confirmation:
        raise NeedsConfirmation(f"{len(cmap.needs_confirmation)} mapping item(s) need confirmation", cmap=cmap, sheet=sheet)
    return cfg, sd, cmap


def _dedupe(records: list[Record], cfg: Config, ledger: Ledger) -> None:
    imported = ledger.imported_keys()
    ledger_hashes = ledger.imported_content_hashes()
    seen_hash: dict[str, Record] = {}
    ordered = sorted(records, key=lambda r: (r.timestamp or datetime.max, r.source_row, r.block_index or 0))
    for rec in ordered:
        if rec.src_key in imported:
            rec.status = RecordStatus.ALREADY_IMPORTED
            continue
        first = seen_hash.get(rec.content_hash)
        if first is not None:
            rec.add("PROBABLE_DUPLICATE", cfg.policy.sev("PROBABLE_DUPLICATE"), "",
                    f"Same content as source row {first.source_row}")
        elif rec.content_hash in ledger_hashes:
            rec.add("PROBABLE_DUPLICATE", cfg.policy.sev("PROBABLE_DUPLICATE"), "",
                    "Same content as a record exported in an earlier batch")
        else:
            seen_hash[rec.content_hash] = rec
    groups: dict[str, list[Record]] = defaultdict(list)
    for rec in records:
        if rec.client_key:
            groups[rec.client_key].append(rec)
    n = 0
    for members in groups.values():
        if len(members) < 2:
            continue
        n += 1
        for rec in members:
            rec.duplicate_group = f"G{n:04d}"
            rec.add("POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_CLIENT", cfg.policy.sev("POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_CLIENT"), "",
                    f"Same client name and mobile in {len(members)} records (group {rec.duplicate_group})")


def _assign_status(rec: Record, team_filter: list[str] | None) -> None:
    if rec.status == RecordStatus.ALREADY_IMPORTED:
        return
    if team_filter and not any(rec.sales_leader.upper().startswith(t.upper()) for t in team_filter):
        rec.status = RecordStatus.EXCLUDED_BY_FILTER
    elif rec.has(Severity.ERROR):
        rec.status = RecordStatus.REVIEW
    elif rec.has(Severity.HELD):
        rec.status = RecordStatus.DUPLICATE_HELD
    else:
        rec.status = RecordStatus.EXPORTED


def reconcile(sd: SheetData, records: list[Record], response_issues: list[Issue]) -> tuple[dict, list]:
    by_status = Counter(r.status.value for r in records)
    per_row = Counter(r.source_row for r in records)
    no_client = len({i.source_row for i in response_issues if i.code == "NO_CLIENT_DATA"})
    extra_blocks = sum(n - 1 for n in per_row.values() if n > 1)
    counts = {
        "data_rows_read": len(sd.rows) + sd.blank_rows,
        "blank_rows": sd.blank_rows,
        "responses": len(sd.rows),
        "responses_no_client": no_client,
        "responses_multi_block": sum(1 for n in per_row.values() if n > 1),
        "records_built": len(records),
        **{f"records_{s.value.lower()}": by_status.get(s.value, 0) for s in RecordStatus},
    }
    outcome = sum(by_status.values())
    responses_accounted = len(per_row) + no_client
    checks = [
        ("data rows = blank rows + responses", counts["data_rows_read"] == counts["blank_rows"] + counts["responses"], ""),
        ("records built = responses − no-client + extra blocks",
         counts["records_built"] == counts["responses"] - no_client + extra_blocks, ""),
        ("records built = exported + review + duplicate held + already imported + excluded",
         counts["records_built"] == outcome and all(r.status is not None for r in records), ""),
        ("every response accounted for exactly once (records or NO_CLIENT_DATA)",
         responses_accounted == counts["responses"] and not (set(per_row) & {i.source_row for i in response_issues}), ""),
    ]
    return counts, checks


def run(opts: RunOptions) -> RunResult:
    cfg, sd, cmap = prepare(opts)
    out_dir = Path(opts.out_dir)
    ledger = Ledger(opts.ledger_path)
    source_sha = file_sha256(opts.source)
    previous = ledger.batches_for_file(source_sha)

    builder = RecordBuilder(cfg, cmap, opts.timestamp_formats, opts.now)
    records: list[Record] = []
    response_issues: list[Issue] = []
    for row_no, values in sd.rows:
        recs, issues = builder.build(SourceResponse(row_no, dict(enumerate(values))))
        records.extend(recs)
        response_issues.extend(issues)

    _dedupe(records, cfg, ledger)
    for rec in records:
        _assign_status(rec, opts.team_filter)

    counts, checks = reconcile(sd, records, response_issues)
    if not all(ok for _, ok, _ in checks):
        failed = [name for name, ok, _ in checks if not ok]
        raise ReconciliationError("Reconciliation failed; nothing exported: " + "; ".join(failed))

    batch_id = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S-") + uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
    result = RunResult(batch_id, sd, cmap, records, response_issues, counts, checks, previous, source_sha,
                       cfg=cfg, dry_run=opts.dry_run)
    exported = sorted(result.exported, key=lambda r: (r.source_row, r.block_index or 0))
    if exported and not opts.dry_run:
        if opts.last_id is None:
            raise ValueError(f"{len(exported)} record(s) are ready to export: enter the last Id in the live MASTERLIST (--last-id).")
        for i, rec in enumerate(exported, start=opts.last_id + 1):
            rec.dest_id = i

    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stem = Path(opts.source).stem.replace(" ", "_")[:40]
    inputs = {Path(opts.source).resolve(), Path(opts.template).resolve()}

    def out_path(prefix: str) -> Path:
        p = out_dir / f"{prefix}_{stem}_{batch_id}.xlsx"
        if p.resolve() in inputs:
            raise ValueError("Output path would overwrite an input file")
        return p

    header, widths = read_template_header(opts.template, cfg.profile)
    if not opts.dry_run:
        p = out_path("FUEL_MASTERLIST_IMPORT")
        for rec in write_masterlist(p, header, widths, exported, cfg.profile):
            rec.add("FORMULA_TEXT_ESCAPED", cfg.policy.sev("FORMULA_TEXT_ESCAPED"), "", "Text starting with '=' written as literal text")
        result.outputs["import"] = p
    if opts.leads_log:
        p = out_path("FUEL_LEADS_LOG")
        write_leads_log(p, [leads_log_row(r.values, r.seller_slot, cfg.profile) for r in exported], cfg.profile)
        result.outputs["leads_log"] = p
    p = out_path("FUEL_IMPORT_AUDIT")
    audit.write_audit(p, result, opts)
    result.outputs["audit"] = p

    if not opts.dry_run:
        try:
            ledger.record_export({
                "batch_id": batch_id, "source_file_name": Path(opts.source).name, "source_file_sha256": source_sha,
                "source_sheet": sd.sheet_name, "mapping_profile_id": cfg.profile.raw.get("profile_id", ""),
                "responses_read": counts["responses"], "records_built": counts["records_built"],
                "records_exported": len(exported), "records_review": counts["records_review"],
                "records_skipped": counts["records_already_imported"], "output_path": str(result.outputs["import"]),
            }, [(r.src_key, r.source_row, r.dest_id, r.content_hash) for r in exported])
        except Exception:
            result.outputs["import"].unlink(missing_ok=True)  # never leave an un-ledgered import file
            raise
    log.info("batch %s: %s", batch_id, {k: v for k, v in counts.items() if k.startswith("records_")})
    return result


def run_from_paths(source: str | Path, template: str | Path, out_dir: str | Path, **kw) -> RunResult:
    return run(RunOptions(Path(source), Path(template), Path(out_dir), **kw))
